newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs resist pressure but hold breath.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs resist pressure but hold breath.

text.p: Belgian linear government bonds (OLOs) are expected to remain steady on Friday ahead of Sunday's runoff French elections and without any fresh news on the gold reserves revaluation row between the Bundesbank and the German government, traders said.

A victory for Left in the second and final round of the French elections FR-POL would send a shockwave through French financial markets and the selling was bound to hit neighbouring Belgium too, they said.
At 0750 GMT the benchmark 2007 OLO BE286= yielded 6.02 percent, down from 6.03 at the close on Thursday.
